body.x: TobyRich (https://tobyrich.com), a maker of smartphone controlled gadgets, unveiled "SmartPlane" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The SmartPlane is the world's first smartphone-controlled gadget airplane. The Smart Plane is ultra light and, with its slow flying speed, it is designed specifically for use in indoor such as hallways, large livingroom, entrance hall, spacious meeting rooms, exhibition halls, and sports halls. The SmartPlane is controlled by tilting and turning the smartphone held on user's palm.
